scope: Explicit validated query binding depth 1 through 32; default 16 unchanged. Engineering coverage, not native Access qualification.
counting_note: Eleven query integration tests and three CLI tests. Repeated runs are not additional tests. Selected existing suites are recorded separately without an aggregate count.

checks.command: cargo test -p tablecraft-query --test binding_depth --test named_crosstabs --test domain --test collation_routing --test progressive_derived_values --test progressive_grouped_values --test progressive_text_group_values --test editing --locked

authoring_corrections: The wide-node guard initially constructed one SQL string that exceeded the parser token ceiling. It now constructs an owned query from individually parsed projections to exercise the binder independently.
limitations: No larger default, parser, named-path, work, allocation or source allowances.
No new SQL grammar or streaming shape support.
Restricted editing preparation retains its default depth.
